verdict.rationale: Snyk documents an official Snyk MCP Server, part of Snyk Studio, that runs locally through the Snyk CLI. Users validate the connection by prompting their coding agent in natural language, and a probe confirms the official MCP server documentation exists. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the exposed MCP tools and per-client configuration steps, independent or hands-on corroboration, any hosted/remote MCP endpoint (only a local server is documented).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Snyk MCP Server is designed as a local MCP server, running on your system using the Snyk CLI to ensure local file access.
To validate the MCP server configuration, prompt your coding agent with natural language, for example, "scan my directory for security issues".
